commands: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; O=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); case "$O" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; test "$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)" = main; git -C "$P" fetch -q --prune origin; git -C "$P" merge --ff-only origin/main; test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" = "5b985f40f60a8856a3efbdddf036e4b17d2447b1"

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test "$(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads | tr '
' ' ')" = "main "; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; printf '%s
' '=== LOCAL ==='; git -C "$P" status --short --branch; git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD; printf '%s
' '=== REMOTE HEADS ==='; git -C "$P" ls-remote --heads origin | awk '{sub("refs/heads/","",$2); print $2}' | sort

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; grep -q 'e03763d019af405087a5fa9c6713a7165d2e623f' "$P/docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md"; grep -q 'Controller behavior quality' "$P/docs/PROJECT_ROADMAP.md"; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)"; test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" = "5b985f40f60a8856a3efbdddf036e4b17d2447b1"
